test_UNet2DConditionModel: test the UNet2DConditionModel class by running forward passes with dummy noise, timestep, and encoder hidden states inputs
create_ip_adapter_state_dict: create an IP-Adapter state dictionary with cross-attention weights and image projection layers for a given UNet model
create_custom_diffusion_layers: create custom diffusion attention processor layers for a UNet model with optional mock weights for training simulation
get_unet_lora_config: get a LoRA configuration with rank 4 targeting to_q, to_k, to_v, and to_out.0 modules for UNet fine-tuning
check_if_lora_correctly_set: check if LoRA layers are correctly set in a UNet model by verifying BaseTunerLayer instances across all modules
